summary_1line: Bhishma devastates the Pandava army until Krishna, enraged, nearly breaks his vow to attack him, before Arjuna rallies and counterattacks with celestial weapons.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna leaps from the chariot, whirling the blazing Sudarshana discus, striding across the trembling battlefield toward Bhishma like a storm god.
Arjuna runs after Krishna and seizes him by both hands and feet, struggling to stop the enraged deity from charging Bhishma.
Bhishma stands fearless on his chariot with bow drawn as Krishna advances with the discus, welcoming death from the god with folded reverence.
